newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: PRESS DIGEST - Sri Lanka Newspapers - April 24.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Sri Lanka Newspapers - April 24.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Sri Lankan press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
Armed gang robs cash and jewellery worth five million on Wednesday in Colombo suburb of Wellawatte.
A total of 174 vehicles reported stolen in the country so far this year, police sources say.
Main opposition United National Party (UNP) to conduct several demonstrations against the proposed Broadcasting Authority.
Chambers of Commerce appeal to members to conserve energy.

The business community which initially took a myopic view of government's economic policies are now seeing the dynamism of the economy due to low interest rates and higher money circulation, says President Chandrika Kumaratunga.

Government to file criminal and civil action against businessmen who took over privatised firms and mismanaged them, says deputy finance iminster G.L. Peiris. The government has taken back six firms which were mismanaged after privatisation by the previous UNP regime.
